body:
WHAT
Connect (open wizard / apply profile), the Vision toggle and the attach-file picker are invoked with the id of the tab they were opened from — a pane header or sidebar row — and the main process acts on that tab's workspace. Only when no tabId is given does main fall back to the focused tab.

WHY
With several workspaces tiled, acting on 'the focused one' silently changed a different workspace's connection.

WHERE
app/renderer/modules/tabs.js — openPaneCtxMenu(e, tabId) → appendConnectionCtxItems(menuEl, tabId); pane attach button calls openAttachPicker(ts.attachments, attachEl(), tabId); resolvePanePermission(tabId, …). app/renderer/modules/workbench.js — openWorkspaceCtxMenu(e, { workspace, tabId }) adds FOCUS / connection items / CLOSE TAB for opts.tabId; sidebar rows register contextmenu with ts.id. app/renderer/modules/util.js — appendConnectionCtxItems passes tabId into openConnectionsWizard("apply", tabId), getVision(tabId), setVision(enabled, tabId). app/renderer/modules/setup.js — wizTargetTabId used by useProfile()/SAVE & CONNECT → applyProfile(id, tabId). app/preload.js — applyProfile/getVision/setVision/pickContextFiles forward tabId. app/main.js — tabFromPayload(payload), ipcMain.handle("profiles:apply"), ("settings:getVision"), ("settings:setVision"), ("context:pickFiles").

TEST CHECKLIST
1. Opening the context menu on pane B while pane A is focused and choosing SET CONNECTION opens the wizard with wizTargetTabId === B; SAVE & CONNECT then invokes profiles:apply with { id, tabId: B }.
2. In main, profiles:apply with tabId B writes .env and .magentra/settings.json under B's workspace and sends set_connection to B's child, leaving A's files and child untouched.
3. settings:setVision with tabId B flips `vision` in B's settings.json even when A is the active tab.
4. The attach picker opened from pane B queries settings:getVision / context:pickFiles with tabId B so image files are offered only if B's workspace has a vision model.
5. A payload without tabId (single-console topbar actions) falls back to the sender window's active tab via tabFromPayload returning null.
